project.name: Defend the Crystal
project.camera_context: High oblique arena camera; enemies move from the arena edge toward the center crystal.
project.performance_target: Maintain the existing smooth local browser loop with several simultaneous enemy instances; formal frame and memory targets remain pending.

asset.name: Crystal Brute
asset.purpose: Replace the procedural enemy visual in the V3 tutorial checkpoint without changing gameplay rules.

source.model_or_pack: Meshy 7 High Detail image-to-3D with PBR texture and fixed-count remesh

rights.notes: Generated on the Meshy Free plan before the later Pro upgrade. Required credit: Model created with Meshy – CC BY 4.0 License.

technical.collider: Existing gameplay sphere radius 0.55; not derived from the render mesh.
technical.scale_units: Runtime-normalized to 1.8 Three.js world units tall
technical.forward_axis: Normalized by the EnemyVisual adapter; runtime visual check required

evidence: Approved turnaround and isolated front, back, and right views
concept.notes: Alex approved Candidate C for the enemy tutorial asset.

rights.notes: Commercial use and modification are allowed with Meshy attribution.

source_quality.notes: Static silhouette and texture were accepted for V3. Deformation topology is untested because the asset is not rigged.

dcc_cleanup.notes: No Blender source or manual UV/topology cleanup exists. The 4096 metallic-roughness texture should be reduced for production.

evidence: V3 uses code-driven root-level walk, attack, hit, and death feedback
rig_and_motion.notes: A skeleton and authored clips are outside the signed V3 boundary.

evidence: GLTFLoader loaded the GLB over HTTP
No required-request, page, console-error, or WebGL failure was observed
engine_import.notes: EnemyVisual measures the mesh, grounds it, clones per-instance materials, and keeps gameplay state outside the render asset.

evidence: Generated enemies were visible in the real arena camera
Real mouse aiming and firing produced five or more kills
Hit, death, crystal attack, failure, and restart paths were observed
game_camera.notes: A low purple emissive fill was added in the visual adapter because the original charcoal texture was too dark against the night arena.

runtime_performance.notes: No formal frame-time or memory budget has been measured.

target_runtime.notes: The declared desktop-web target passed. Mobile and lower-end hardware remain outside the V3 target.

test_reports: 2026-08-16 V3 build, normal-asset playtest, missing-asset fallback, failure, and restart proof recorded in the 10x-os scope

decision.notes: Suitable for the V3 tutorial checkpoint after browser proof. Not production-ready because DCC cleanup, texture reduction, formal performance, and target-runtime gates remain open.
